name: fs-explorer
description: 集文件浏览、Git 浏览与轻量操作于一体的桌面应用（Tauri + React）

scripts.install:local: pnpm --filter @fs-explorer/desktop tauri:build:app && rm -rf "/Applications/FS Explorer.app" && cp -R "apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/FS Explorer.app" /Applications/
scripts.check:rs: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
